products.name: ROBCodeAgent
products.headline: Your coding sessions. Within reach.
products.description: Keep multiple Codex sessions moving from iPhone or iPad. Follow live output, steer prompts, and continue work through the paired companion on your Mac.
products.requirement: Requires ROBCodeAgent Bridge, a working Codex CLI installation, and local Wi-Fi.

products.name: CodeAtlas: 3D Code Map
products.headline: See how your code connects.
products.description: Explore a 3D architecture map, trace the impact of Git changes, and find hotspots and gaps in test coverage. Analyze Swift, Objective-C, C, C++, and Python locally.
products.requirement: Source analysis stays on your Mac. No project build required.

products.name: LingonXRob Plist Editor
products.headline: Give launchd files a clear interface.
products.description: Create and edit launchd property lists with native controls for commands, schedules, paths, and advanced keys. Preserve unrecognized fields in existing files.
products.requirement: A sandboxed file editor. Saving a plist does not install or run a job.

products.name: ROB Training
products.headline: Meet ROB. Master the mission.
products.description: Drive ROB through 24 missions, collect energy, unlock tools, and plan your route through moving obstacles. Explore the robot in AR Lab and learn with ROB Voice.
products.requirement: A simulated robotics game with no physical robot required.

products.name: Musimotion Pro
products.description: An expressive studio for animation, painting, physics, and live performance. macOS 1.0.0 is submitted and waiting for Apple review; the iPhone and iPad release is not yet available.

products.name: ROB Training Vision
products.description: A dedicated spatial robotics workshop for Apple Vision Pro. The separate visionOS edition is in development and is not yet available on the App Store.

products.name: SignalAtlas
products.description: Record Wi-Fi and Bluetooth observations, compare signal strength, and keep receiver-location history. Launch price: $4.99 US. Version 1.0.0 is submitted and waiting for Apple review; not yet available to download.

products.name: SignalAtlas GPS
products.description: Free location companion for the separately sold SignalAtlas Mac app. Share fresh receiver fixes on your local network while the app is open. Version 1.0.0 is submitted and waiting for Apple review; not yet available to download.
